The season ran from 18 March to 5 November 2000. [[C.D. Primeiro de Agosto|Primeiro de Agosto]] were the defending champions. The league comprised 14 teams, the bottom three of which were relegated to the 2001 [[Gira Angola]]. [[Atlético Petróleos de Luanda|Petro de Luanda]] were crowned champions, winning their 12th title,{{cite web |url=http://www.portalangop.co.ao/angola/pt_pt/noticias/desporto/2000/10/45/,b4dd0ba4-7642-4901-a985-185a040feda5.html |title=O Petro-atletico de Luanda regressou asconquistas na divisão maior do futebol angolano |publisher=ANGOP.com |date= 6 Nov 2000 |access-date= 18 Sep 2015 |language=pt}} while [[Associação Recreativa do Amboim|ARA da Gabela]], [[Sporting Clube Petróleos de Cabinda|Sporting de Cabinda]] and [[Sporting Clube Petróleos do Bié|Sporting do Bié]], were relegated. ''[[João Ntinu Pedro|Blanchard]]'' of [[S.L. Benfica (Luanda)|Benfica de Luanda]] finished as the top scorer with 19 goals.{{cite web |url=http://www.portalangop.co.ao/angola/pt_pt/noticias/desporto/2000/10/45/,dad1bc13-61f8-4a33-9c47-ba1f54e4e3e0.html |title=o avançado Blanchard, do Benfica de Luanda, com 19 golos, foi o melhor marcador do campeonato nacional de Futebol |publisher=ANGOP.com |date=6 Nov 2000 |access-date=20 Sep 2015 |language=pt}} ==Changes from the 1999 season== '''Relegated:''' [[Independente Sport Clube|Independente do Tômbwa]] and [[Progresso Associação do Sambizanga|Progresso do Sambizanga]]
